description: Defines the Allocator interface for memory management, including methods for allocation, deallocation, capacity, and tracking allocations.

classes.name: Allocator
classes.description: Abstract class defining a standard interface for memory allocators, including methods for allocating, freeing, and querying memory.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of the specified size without alignment constraints.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of the specified size with the specified alignment.

methods.name: AllocateForAlignment
methods.description: Allocates memory suitable for a specific alignment, possibly returning a larger block to accommodate alignment padding.

methods.name: Free
methods.description: Frees a previously allocated memory block.

methods.name: FreeWithSize
methods.description: Frees a memory block with an associated size, defaulting to calling Free.

methods.name: GetCapacity
methods.description: Returns the total capacity available for allocations.

methods.name: GetAllocated
methods.description: Returns the total memory currently allocated.

methods.name: PrintAllocations
methods.description: Prints information about all current allocations.
